review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: The given bar chart illustrates how citizens in three UK metropolises differed in their choices for accommodation units in 2009.

Overall, the share of residents in Liverpool choosing to live in apartments was the highest, while semi-detached houses was the most attracted to dwellers in London and Manchester. Also of note is that the least appealing housing types being witnessed in all surveyed cities was terraced houses.

To elaborate, 57% of the total examined citizens in Liverpool preferred to reside in apartment, marked the highest point in the graph. However, the figures for London and Manchester being showed that semi-detached houses was the most favoured.

Regarding categories with other datas, the percentage of dwellers in three cities were around 15%, 25% and 35%, respectively. Meanwhile, Terraced houses was the least preferred to all surveyed cities, at under 20% each.

completion.comment: Em đã viết đủ mở bài, Overview và hai Detail.

review.overall: Em đã viết đủ bốn phần và xác định đúng apartments cao nhất ở Liverpool, semi-detached dẫn đầu London/Manchester, terraced thấp nhất; 57% là ước lượng chấp nhận được và 15/25/35% đúng. Bài hiện khoảng 139 từ, dưới mức ít nhất 150 từ của đề; đó là thiếu yêu cầu độ dài, không chứng minh em viết chậm. Bài còn ẩu ở khâu tự soát câu: “houses was” lặp, “being showed” sai động từ, “datas” sai dạng và ba tỷ lệ detached không được gắn tên loại nhà. Detail 1 cũng thiếu mức khoảng 37% cho hai thành phố. Em cần nghiêm túc, cầu thị sửa từng khung câu rồi tự đối chiếu chủ ngữ, động từ và nhãn số trước khi nộp.

paragraphs: The given bar chart illustrates how citizens in three UK metropolises differed in their choices for accommodation units in 2009.

Overall, the share of residents in Liverpool choosing to live in apartments was the highest, while semi-detached houses were the most attractive to dwellers in London and Manchester. Also of note is that the least appealing housing type in all surveyed cities was terraced houses.

To elaborate, 57% of the surveyed citizens in Liverpool preferred to reside in apartments. This proportion was the highest in the graph. By comparison, about 29% of London residents and 19% of Manchester residents chose apartments. However, the figures for London and Manchester showed that semi-detached houses were the most favoured, at about 37% in each city.

Regarding the remaining categories, the percentages choosing detached houses in Liverpool, London and Manchester were around 15%, 25% and 35%, respectively. Meanwhile, Terraced houses were the least preferred in all surveyed cities, at under 20% each.

nextSteps: Viết lại Overview, gạch dưới houses và dùng were; phân biệt attractive với attracted.
Viết lại Detail 1 có khoảng 37% mỗi nơi, Detail 2 nêu tên detached trước 15/25/35%.
Tự làm bảng kiểm cuối bài: data, số ít/số nhiều, động từ hữu hạn, loại nhà và thành phố ứng với từng tỷ lệ.

task.text:

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
